name: Chicago Deep
settings: F ENV / A D S R
A ENV / A D S R
seq: Optional: press PLAY, set DIRECTION to PAT and hold notes to arpeggiate.
play: Moog's own walkthrough bass: round and heavy. For darker dub/EBM use, drop CUTOFF to 8 o'clock and push FB/EXT IN to 10 o'clock for grit.

name: Ash Engine
settings: F ENV / A D S R
A ENV / A D S R
seq: DIRECTION SEQ, RECORD, 16 steps: D D D' D | D F D C' | D D Ab D | D' D F Eb (' = octave up). TEMPO 124. Gate 50% (SETTINGS PGM 3, then PGM 8). Parameter-record CUTOFF up on steps 5 and 13 (SEQ pressed twice so it flashes, hold step, turn knob).
play: Classic Front 242 / Nitzer Ebb machine bass. Ride CUTOFF and EG AMOUNT live; the flat-2 (Eb) and flat-5 (Ab) keep it from sounding generic.

name: Rivet
settings: F ENV / A D S R
A ENV / A D S R
F ENV ASSIGN (hold F ENV LOOP 2 s), turn OSC 1 WAVESHAPE, depth PGM 5 (negative: more fold on attack), press F ENV LOOP to save (est.)
play: A folded, metallic bite on each note that settles into a hollow square tone: good for industrial/EBM basslines. Turn Osc 1 WAVESHAPE toward 7 o'clock for a nastier attack.

name: Black Sub
settings: F ENV / A D S R
A ENV / A D S R
play: Sub-oscillator-led low end with a slow pulse-width wobble, as SOS suggests. Lengthen A ENV RELEASE to about 11 o'clock for long, 808-style hip hop tails.

name: Nightdrive
settings: F ENV / A D S R
A ENV / A D S R
seq: ARP: DIRECTION PAT, SETTINGS PGM 1 = Up, SETTINGS PGM 2 = '2 notes, each followed by its octave', clock division 1/16 (SETTINGS PGM 9). TEMPO 105. Press HOLD, then hold one root (A or F#) and change roots per bar.
play: Darksynth octave-pump bass. Turning RES BASS off follows a Gearspace tip for a more traditional Moog sound; turn it back on for a thicker, more driven low end.

name: Corroded Acid
settings: F ENV / A D S R
A ENV / A D S R
seq: 16 steps, TEMPO 128, gate 50%: C C C' C | Eb C F# C | C Bb C' C | Ab C Eb' C. Tie step 7 with HOLD. Parameter-record RESONANCE up on step 5 and CUTOFF up on step 11. Optional: gate probability about 80% on steps 12-16 (SETTINGS PGM 6).
play: Gritty 303-style line without the rubbery slides. Sweep CUTOFF and EG AMOUNT together. A small GLIDE amount is the only way to get real slides, but it is left off here.
sourceName: Sound On Sound review (303-style tones) + Manual

name: Feedback Grinder
settings: F ENV / A D S R
A ENV / A D S R
SETTINGS, PGM 13 (aftertouch), turn FB/EXT IN, depth PGM 12, press SETTINGS (est.)
play: Full mixer levels plus the feedback loop give heavy, saturated industrial distortion. Press harder into the keys to drive the feedback further.

name: Rust Fold
settings: F ENV / A D S R
A ENV / A D S R
play: A West Coast-style folded lead that slowly churns as the LFO moves the fold. Use the mod wheel for vibrato, and play in Phrygian for a cold, alien feel.

name: Sync Scream
settings: F ENV / A D S R
A ENV / A D S R
play: The piercing hard-sync lead Gearnews describes, with the filter envelope sweeping the synced oscillator on each note. Shorten F ENV DECAY for a stabby darksynth hit.

name: Tape Ghost
settings: F ENV / A D S R
A ENV / A D S R
LFO 1 ASSIGN (hold KB RESET 2 s), turn TUNE slightly, depth PGM 9 (tape wow), press KB RESET (est.)
play: Based on SOS's simple lead: one triangle, a touch of feedback, filtered, with slight pitch wobble. Put a tape echo after it (e.g. Arturia Delay TAPE-201) for haunted lo-fi hip hop melodies.

name: Fifth Column
settings: F ENV / A D S R
A ENV / A D S R
play: Stacked fifths give a power-chord lead (Perfect Circuit's +7 tip), heavy and martial over minor-key EBM. For something darker, set OSC 2 FREQ to about 7:50 (-6 semitones, a tritone below).

name: Wire Sine
settings: 10 o'clock for a metallic edge (est.); Osc 2 at 8', triangle
A ENV / A D S R
CUTOFF, 1 o'clock (mod wheel = vibrato on the filter sine) (est.)
play: The self-oscillating filter as a pure sine voice, theremin-like but without the slide. Perfect Circuit found the tracking slightly off over several octaves, so keep lines within about an octave and a half.

name: Iron Lung
settings: F ENV / A D S R
A ENV / A D S R
play: Hold a low note with HOLD on. The looping filter envelope breathes slowly while light FM and drift keep the tone unstable. SOS calls the FM unpredictable, so adjust MOD AMOUNT slowly.

name: Static Choir
settings: F ENV / A D S R
A ENV / A D S R
play: A band-passed, vowel-like mono pad (SOS mentions vocal timbres). For two-note intervals, hold SYNC 1->2 until it blinks to enter Duophonic mode (firmware 1.1.0+).
sourceName: Sound On Sound review + Moog help (duophonic)

name: Haunt Box
settings: F ENV / A D S R
A ENV / A D S R
LFO 1 ASSIGN to TUNE, depth PGM 9, LFO 1 triangle at 10 o'clock (warped music box) (est.)
play: An FM bell and music-box tone, starting from triangles as the manual recommends for FM, with a slight warp. Good in spooky Geto Boys-style lo-fi loops; resample it and pitch it down on the MPC.

name: Rust Bell
settings: Init (alt: start from a Bank 11 Mallets and Metal preset)
F ENV / A D S R
A ENV / A D S R
play: Layered oscillators, FM and the band-pass filter, following Moog's metallic-percussion approach. Gives industrial clangs; turn OSC 2 FREQ for different metals.

name: Bone Pluck
settings: F ENV / A D S R
A ENV / A D S R
SETTINGS, PGM 12 (velocity), turn OSC 1 WAVESHAPE, depth PGM 5 (harder = more fold), press SETTINGS (est.)
seq: Works well in ARP: pattern Leapfrog Down, TEMPO 96, held notes A C Eb.
play: A short, woody pluck that gets more folded and brittle the harder you play. The manual's short-decay filter-envelope pluck technique with a wavefolder added.

name: Pit Kick
settings: Init (alt: start from a Bank 14 Percussion preset)
F ENV / A D S R
A ENV / A D S R
play: Moog's approach: a triangle body, a little saw for click, and the filter envelope creating the pitch drop. Alternative: mixer all off, RESONANCE at 5 o'clock, EG AMOUNT at 3:30 and F ENV DECAY at 9 gives a pure self-oscillating filter kick. Sample it into the MPC.

name: Sheet Snare
settings: F ENV / A D S R
A ENV / A D S R
play: Triangle shell plus noise for the wires, per Moog's recipe, with feedback grit for an industrial crack. Lengthen A ENV DECAY for a gated-room EBM snare.

name: Cold Hats
settings: A ENV / A D S R (closed)
A ENV / A D S R (open)
seq: 16 steps on one note, 1/16 division, TEMPO to taste. Gate probability about 70% on off-beats (SETTINGS PGM 6) for a loose, human pattern.
play: High-passed noise with decay setting closed or open, as in Moog's demo. Resample it into the MPC, or sequence it on its own for ticking industrial hats.

name: Burst Clap
settings: LFO 1 ASSIGN (hold KB RESET 2 s), turn mixer NOISE, depth PGM 4 (negative chop), press KB RESET (est.)
A ENV / A D S R
play: A fast LFO chopping the noise into a burst, as Moog suggests for claps. KB RESET makes every hit identical. Turn LFO 1 RATE to tighten or loosen the flam.

name: Anvil Zap
settings: Init (alt: start from a Bank 15 Effects preset)
F ENV / A D S R
A ENV / A D S R
play: Wavefold, sync and feedback together (Perfect Circuit's edgy-combination tip) produce a struck-metal zap. Play low for impacts and high for sparks.

name: Air Raid
settings: A ENV / A D S R
play: The self-oscillating filter swept by a slow triangle gives a distant siren. Press HOLD and drown it in reverb for dark-ambient intros. Saw shape gives a falling siren, ramp a rising one.

name: Cold Data
settings: F ENV / A D S R
A ENV / A D S R
SETTINGS, PGM 11 (KB S+H), turn CUTOFF, depth PGM 12, press SETTINGS
seq: Length 13 steps (SETTINGS PGM 7) for a polymeter against 4/4. TEMPO 118, 1/16 division. Note pool D Eb F Ab A C, with D added twice (SETTINGS PGM 5). Note probability 40% on about 6 steps (PGM 4). Gate probability 75% (PGM 6).
play: A generative cold-wave line that never quite repeats, with random cutoff per note from KB S+H. Lower note probability for a steadier line.

name: Black Stairs
settings: Init (alt: start from a Bank 7 Arpeggiations preset)
F ENV / A D S R
A ENV / A D S R
seq: ARP: DIRECTION PAT, pattern Leapfrog Down (SETTINGS PGM 1), octave 'random within 2 octaves' (PGM 2), press RECORD in ARP mode for pendulum. Press ARP and switch off PGM 4, 8, 11 and 15 for a broken rhythm. TEMPO 110. HOLD D F Ab C#.
play: A diminished-flavoured darksynth arp falling down the stairs while a tempo-synced LFO slowly opens the filter. Change one held note per bar for movement.
